Q2: Potassium oxide is not found on any lists of concern or low hazard. Given the high number of data-deficient hazard classifications, its absence from lists of concern may indicate a lack of study rather than confirmed safety.
Q3: Potassium oxide is a well-defined chemical with extensive general literature (70,000 references).
